leaves.name: degHomogPolyNoEmb
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), section 19 (locator UNVERIFIED; the statement used in the proof of 19 Thm 4): deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(X), read in coordinates of a finite family e_1..e_r, restricted to algebraically closed fields with no ring homomorphism to C (characteristic p, or characteristic 0 of transcendence degree above the continuum). Over fields that embed into C it is proved (degpoly-proof). charpoly-p: this leaf alone gives the field (End(A) finite over Z is not needed: bounded-degree polynomials in phi and q-adic integrality of P0).
leaves.flag: unread: specialization (forall-instance) of deg-det's printed leaf DegHomogPoly (Mumford 19) to fields with no embedding into C; the characteristic-p case is used (T7 at the reduction mod p); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 19 (deg homogeneous polynomial of degree 2g on End X), fields with no embedding into C

note: charpoly-p: charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed from DegHomogPolyNoEmb alone (no homFreeFiniteAlgClosed, no other open field): fields with k -> C by degpoly-proof's CharPolyLattice with uniformizationLeafAll_proof and mumfordTorsionAlgClosed_proof; other fields by deg-det's route with the finiteness of End(A) removed (CharPolyCharP/Algebra.lean). Count-neutral. Report docs/research/charpoly-p.md.
